text: This report recommends that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one (1) City-owned tree located on the road allowance fronting 209 Rosedale Heights Drive. The application indicates the reason for removal is to address concerns over the irregular form of the tree. The subject tree is a little-leaved linden (Tilia cordata), measuring 65 cm in diameter. The Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.

City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one (1) City-owned tree located on the road allowance fronting 209 Rosedale Heights Drive.
